title: Plant–Microbiome–Metabolome Discovery Initiative
summary: Integrate plant science, microbiome profiling, metabolomics and AI to prioritize understudied bioactive mechanisms for subsequent experimental validation.
research_gap: Plant secondary metabolites, environmental context and associated microbial communities are often studied separately, limiting integrated discovery of context-dependent bioactivity.
hypothesis: Joint modelling of plant, metabolomic and microbial features can prioritize reproducible biological relationships that are missed by single-domain analyses.

title: Explainable Multimodal Biomarker Discovery
summary: Develop an interpretable framework combining clinical, omics and imaging signals to identify robust biomarkers while explicitly controlling data leakage and generalization error.
research_gap: High-performing biomarker models can fail to generalize because information leakage, cohort shift and opaque modelling are not assessed consistently across data modalities.
hypothesis: Leakage-aware multimodal modelling with external validation and interpretable feature stability can produce more trustworthy biomarker candidates.

title: AI-Assisted Natural Product Drug Discovery Network
summary: Link natural-product knowledge, target biology, molecular modelling, toxicity assessment and laboratory validation in a staged discovery pipeline.
research_gap: Natural-product screening studies frequently stop at isolated in-silico predictions without integrated target evidence, toxicity characterization and independent validation.
hypothesis: A staged evidence-to-experiment workflow can reduce false-positive prioritization and identify better-supported natural-product candidates.
